name: StakeWise Data Query
description: Ask plain-English questions about StakeWise V3 staking data — APY, vault TVL, your stake or earnings, exit-queue ETA, osETH/osGNO mint capacity or health factor, boost/leverage LTV, distributor (merkle) claims, vesting, exchange rates, sub-vaults. Read-only; the model queries the public StakeWise subgraphs + backend GraphQL on Mainnet and Gnosis via its fetch/exec tools. No SDK or local server.
